intro.title: Hematite Bracelets
intro.descriptionHtml: Exclusive range of natural Hematite Bracelets beautifully strung in different designs. Natural Hematite is a stone for the mind and is associated with clarity of thought and control of stress. This stone offers a lot of therapeutic and spiritual benefits. It calms down the mental stress and the emotions to allow rational thoughts and wise decision making. Being an iron based stone, this is the stone for healing, grounding, fortune telling, meditation, stabilization and protection. For those unable to control their mind, lose clarity of thoughts and unable to make wise decision, this is the stone of guidance.
